text: Chapter 13: The Water Tribe and Coenubia@Shadow from the Abyss
■Next Mission\nMove from Aquacity to\nthe Parliament Hall to start.
The Ranas have agreed to form an alliance with the Eumanos,\nbut the mystery in the deep sea remains unsolved.\nAccept the request and head out to investigate the deep sea!
You have reached Aqua Gota's deep sea.\nGo to the deepest zone to find out what is happening!
As you begin to dive, you see bubbles with Coenubia monsters\ninside. They seem to be weak to water. Deal with them and\nkeep going!
Vatudo has been waiting for you in the plastida in the\ndeepest zone of the deep sea. As you are struggling, the\nKnight of Thorns shows up. Fight together to defeat Vatudo!
[[N]]Go to the Path to the Deep Sea
